strassenbrau.name: Straßenbräu
strassenbrau.highlight: A taproom with 14 taps in Friedrichshain and no food, so eat first.

heidenpeters.name: Heidenpeters
heidenpeters.highlight: Taproom in a corner of Markthalle Neun with the brewery in the basement below, so there is food around.

neulich.name: Neulich
neulich.highlight: Brewpub in the Schillerkiez that has brewed on site since 2017, known for experimental beers such as an ice cream pale ale and a chocolate stout.

brauhaussuedstern.name: Brauhaus Südstern
brauhaussuedstern.highlight: Brewery with food and a beer garden next to Hasenheide park, but service can be slow so give it time.

schoppebrau.name: Schoppe Bräu
schoppebrau.highlight: A tiny taproom with just one couch table for 8 to 10 people.

berlinerberg.name: Berliner Berg
berlinerberg.highlight: Beer garden with Berliner Weisse where you can bring your own food.

schalander.name: Schalander
schalander.highlight: Brewpub in the RAW area with a beer garden and flammkuchen on the menu.

protokoll.name: Protokoll
protokoll.highlight: Small taproom serving four of its own beers, with no food on the menu.

georgbrau.name: Georgbräu
georgbrau.highlight: Brewery with food on the Spreeufer in the Nikolaiviertel.

brauhausspandau.name: Brauhaus Spandau
brauhausspandau.highlight: Brewpub in Spandau with food and a large beer garden; it is best to book ahead, especially if you go during the Christmas market.

eschenbrau.name: Eschenbräu
eschenbrau.highlight: Large brewery with pretzels and flammkuchen; book about two weeks ahead.

vagabundkesselhaus.name: Vagabund Kesselhaus
vagabundkesselhaus.highlight: Brewery with food in a former power station in Wedding.

circus.name: Circus
circus.highlight: Come for the Hoff museum and the one beer on tap; there is no food in the brewery.

schankhallepfefferberg.name: Schankhalle Pfefferberg
schankhallepfefferberg.highlight: Large brewpub with a beer garden in the Pfefferberg complex.

marcusbrau.name: Marcus-Bräu
marcusbrau.highlight: Family-run brewery near Alexanderplatz, going since 1982, with reasonable prices for normal food and good service, though opinions on the beer were split.

lemkehackeschermarkt.name: Lemke Hackescher Markt
lemkehackeschermarkt.highlight: Large Berliner Weisse brewery in the S-Bahn arches at Hackescher Markt, with strong beer but weaker service.

brlo.name: BRLO Brwhouse
brlo.highlight: Craft brewhouse with a full kitchen; book ahead for groups.

brewdogdogtap.name: BrewDog DogTap
brewdogdogtap.highlight: A large taproom and beer garden on the former Mariendorf gasworks site.

schlossplatzbrauereikoepenick.name: Schlossplatzbrauerei Köpenick
schlossplatzbrauereikoepenick.highlight: Once Germany’s smallest microbrewery, a tiny glass-walled brewhouse in Köpenick, but it no longer brews on site.

schneeeulesalon.name: Schneeeule Salon
schneeeulesalon.highlight: A taproom dedicated to traditional Berliner Weisse.

lindenbraeu.name: LindenBräu
lindenbraeu.highlight: A brewpub at Potsdamer Platz serving German cuisine that no longer brews on site.
